parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.stem: $K_{pc}$ of benzoic acid between octan-1-ol and water is 79.4.
parts.text:
A solution of $0.400\text{ g}$ of benzoic acid in $25.0\text{ cm}^3$ octan-1-ol is shaken with $125\text{ cm}^3$ of water.

Calculate the mass of benzoic acid extracted into the water layer.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: $K_{pc}$ of benzophenone, $\text{C}_6\text{H}_5\text{COC}_6\text{H}_5$, between octan-1-ol and water is different from the value of $K_{pc}$ of benzoic acid given in (b)(i). Explain why.

parts.label: (c)(i)
parts.stem:
Benzophenone can be synthesised from benzoic acid in two steps as shown.

In step 1 compound **J**, a reactive reaction intermediate, is formed.

Compound **J** then reacts with an organic compound, **K**, to form benzophenone.

{{figure:pdf_visual_01.png}}
parts.text: Deduce the identities of organic compounds **J** and **K** and draw their structures in the boxes.

parts.label: (c)(ii)
parts.text: Suggest reagents and conditions for step 1.

parts.label: (d)(i)
parts.stem:
Benzophenone can also be synthesised in two steps from bromomethylbenzene.

{{figure:pdf_visual_02.png}}
parts.text: Deduce the identity of compound **L** and draw its structure in the box.

parts.label: (d)(ii)
parts.text: Name the mechanism of step 3 and suggest reagents and conditions for step 3.

parts.label: (d)(iii)
parts.text: Deduce the type of reaction in step 4.
